svg.title: The dr-strange code graph · how it works, and what owns what
svg.desc: Source tree → sandboxed wasm plugins → plane → seven verbs → agent. The one red line here is snippet: it finds the node by req.plane but reads the file through a process-wide singleton, so it stands on two sources at once.
svg.text: One drsg process — one database, one tree, one source_root
